title: Meet the Ecosystem: Partners and Customers at WeAreDevelopers with Docker
summary: Meet the partners and customers bringing practical AI, security, and development sessions to the Docker Pavilion at WeAreDevelopers. The post explains why a strong ecosystem matters to developers, announces the sessions and speakers, and invites attendees to connect with the teams building and using these technologies.
author: Jin Kim
